title: Improving Counterfactual Generation for Fair Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual token substitution of racial, ethnic, and national identity tokens (e.g., 'Asian', 'Mexican', 'White', 'Immigrant') in hate speech datasets to measure Counterfactual Token Fairness (CTF) based on model prediction logit differences.
Counterfactual token substitution of religious group tokens (e.g., 'Jewish', 'Muslim', 'Christian') to generate counterfactuals and measure Counterfactual Token Fairness (CTF) via output logits.

Counterfactual token substitution of gender-related group tokens (e.g., 'women', 'transgender', 'nonbinary') to evaluate Counterfactual Token Fairness (CTF) and equalize model predictions across interchangeable contexts.
Counterfactual token substitution of sexual orientation tokens (e.g., 'gay', 'lesbian', 'heterosexual') to assess Counterfactual Token Fairness (CTF) differences in hate speech classifier logits.
Counterfactual token substitution of age-related tokens (e.g., 'elderly', 'millenial', 'young') to measure Counterfactual Token Fairness (CTF) based on model prediction variance.
Counterfactual token substitution of disability-related tokens (e.g., 'paralytic', 'blind', 'deaf') to generate counterfactuals and measure Counterfactual Token Fairness (CTF).
Counterfactual token substitution of political affiliation tokens (e.g., 'democrat', 'republican', 'communist') to evaluate Counterfactual Token Fairness (CTF) across ideological groups.
